title: Deliver automatic plan-v2 monitor through V6
description:
Deliver the automatic plan-v2 product as one human-testable batch, replacing the existing manual V1–V3 workflow and adding V4, V5 and V6.

Product contract:
- Installed extension is ON by default. TYPESAFE_API_KEY is mandatory; missing/blank or rejected credentials produce one clear error and OFF, not a local-only fallback.
- Actual TypeSafe Jev calls are the sole semantic runtime. No general-purpose/reasoning LLM, generated task descriptions, generated summaries or model-written labels. Code owns task IDs, arithmetic, state and score/Choice display mappings.
- Commands only: /progress on, off, interval <seconds>. Bare command gives usage/state. No consent, details, source/Apply, enable/pause/resume, manual scope/current-task selection, or compatibility aliases.
- Automatically extract task-like spans from actual active-branch conversation, reconcile evolving scope/stable identities, infer current task, and apply explicit done/reopen/cancel reports in lineage order. Percentage is reported completed / active discovered tasks, never effort or correctness.
- Proposed operational defaults from plan v2:60s cycle interval, configurable5–86400s; at most3 serial requests/cycle, single flight,10s deadline,24KiB request/20questions. No repeated calls for unchanged successful evidence, fixed15s dispatch override, or60-attempt lifetime wall. Autonomous bounded retry/backoff, not a resume command.
- Preserve passive main-session behavior. No agent message injection, tool replacement, project commands/tests, issue mutation, child monitoring or sibling evidence.
- V4: automatic grounded Beads identity/context enrichment, not a source picker or whole-backlog counter. V5: new-red applicability plus distinct Not needed/Reported red/Observed red. V6: criterion-linked implementation evidence, separate from reported completion. V7 temporal meaningful-progress/stuck/drift is excluded from this requested batch.

Implementation discipline: main authors failing behavior tests before scoped writers; writers never edit tests. Serial working increments, one production writer/cwd. Use jj conventional commits, no new branches. Keep ignored task artifacts, Bun/Biome/TypeScript/Knip/Vitest and make format/check/test. Remove obsolete code and checkpoint schema without compatibility migrations. One bounded independent full-batch review after integration; timeout is not approval.

Delivery requires actual no-command Pi+Jev demonstration and bounded live evaluation, not just injected transport tests. Record usage/errors/limitations; no uncontrolled billable sweep. Detailed plan remains ignored at .agents/plans/20260918T154145--replan-automatic-conversation-monitor__planning/plan_v2.md; child issue bodies are self-contained.

Supersedes old manual-workflow delivery epic pi-progress-barroot-1t2. Its completed work is reusable history, not evidence the new product is delivered. Old independent review timed out without verdict.
acceptance_criteria: Install with key and converse normally: automatic reported progress plus clarity/acceptance, red-test and implementation signals; optional Beads grounding. Only on/off/interval controls. No extra LLM or intervention. Deterministic and bounded real-Jev validation, full-batch review, packaged user-test checkpoint. V7 excluded.

title: Plan-v2 step 1: Automatic Jev progress loop
description:
Replace manual V1 startup with a minimal working automatic conversation->real Jev->reported progress loop. This is an end-to-end visible increment, not merely a default-on empty widget.

Implement: startup ON with TYPESAFE_API_KEY; missing/blank key one error and OFF; rejected credentials error+OFF. Only /progress on|off|interval <seconds>, bare usage/state. Remove consent/source/Apply/details/enable/pause/resume flows and aliases. No manual checklist/current-task setup. On/off idempotent; off aborts/invalidate pending responses, stops collection/network/timers and hides widget. Preserve current-session controls over reload; new sessions default ON, tree must not undo OFF. Interval controls analysis-cycle starts (default60s,5–86400s), including while OFF. No unchanged-history calls. One valid short natural-language request must discover tasks and then explicit completion automatically.

Use existing fixed TypeSafe endpoint/pinned Jev gateway and typed source spans; no general-purpose LLM or fake/local-only runtime. Keep ledger report arithmetic independent from assessment. Delete manual checklist-only runtime paths; relocate shared constants rather than retain dead modules. Version new checkpoint schema, ignore obsolete manual-source checkpoints and rebuild from active history; no migration layer. Reuse useful safety code, not obsolete UX.

Likely areas: src/index.ts, core/monitor.ts, ui/commands.ts, widget.ts, analysis/gateway.ts, sources/conversation.ts; package description/README must describe actual stage accurately.

Main-owned tests first: no-key/blank-key/off, key present without consent, short two-task request and explicit report without commands, invalid/repeated toggles and intervals, timer replacement, no calls on redraw/empty unchanged session, no agent/tool/exec effects. Child implementers may run, not edit, tests. Real endpoint required in runtime; injected transport exists only in tests. Full live quality gate belongs to final delivery ticket, not an unbounded call during this step.

Done when ordinary short conversation yields a reported fraction automatically, controls/key failures work, obsolete manual command paths are absent, and available format/check/test gates pass. Large-history and complex scope guarantees arrive in dependent steps, not claimed here.
acceptance_criteria: Valid key+ordinary short conversation yields tasks and reported progress without commands. Missing key error+OFF; only on/off/interval; no consent/source/local-only path; idempotent lifecycle; main-owned behavior tests and gates pass.
close_reason: Automatic default-on Jev loop, strict controls, key failure handling, and no-command task/report flow verified

title: Plan-v2 step 2: Incremental history and exact task spans
description:
Extend the working automatic loop to arbitrary-length current-branch history without lifetime-prefix truncation or candidate-shortlist starvation.

Read finalized entries from getBranch, never sibling/child sessions. Account for message_end preceding persistence; timer/settled observations capture originals. Cursor = committed entry ID/hash/span offset, not fetched/dispatched position. Start bounded chronological catch-up when no valid checkpoint; append new arrivals without restarting in-flight discovery. Initial working bounds:32 visible messages/window,256KiB text,24KiB serialized requests,20questions/request; windows roll indefinitely. References survive RAM eviction and rehydrate from current-branch originals. Deduplicate live/persisted entries, own metadata and overlap. Distinguish window absence from genuinely unavailable originals. Automatically recover available ancestors/checkpoints; no source reselection. Irrecoverable gaps remain visible; later explicitly self-contained goal may establish a new trustworthy scope without inventing old status.

Candidate enumeration is mechanical: Markdown blocks/list items, sentence segmentation and proposed clause boundaries with exact offsets. Keep whole-span/child alternatives and source context (quotes/code/examples); Jev decides actionable task boundaries, including structured lists. Never count both overlapping parent and children, never split every 'and' into tasks, never synthesize task wording or use another LLM. Overlong messages become offset-linked subchunks; indivisible evidence overflow is visible Unknown, not silent clipping. Use all bounded candidate batches over time, not a permanent first12 shortlist. No task admission from regex alone.

Likely areas: sources/trajectory.ts, candidates.ts, conversation controller/cursor/checkpoints. Preserve active-branch provenance and privacy filtering. Deferred V5 adds narrow tool-fact adapters; generic tool bodies remain excluded as task/status authority.

Main tests first: >512 entries/>256KiB lifetime history reaches tail; oversized message continues after restart; new arrivals don't reset pending work; compound prose versus 'compare authentication and authorization'; wrapped bullets, numbered examples, quotes, parent/child overlap, aborted messages; private/system/thinking/sibling exclusion; own checkpoints cause no feedback loop; recoverable versus irrecoverable gaps. No paid calls for structural tests.

Done when visible catching-up state advances to current automatic task progress on long replay with no lost/duplicate observations, bounded working state/requests and passing gates.
acceptance_criteria: Long history and oversized messages reach latest evidence with bounded windows, exact offsets and committed cursor; no permanent prefix/shortlist, restart starvation, parent-child double count, sibling or private evidence. Automatic recovery and tests/gates pass.
close_reason: Rolling bounded history reaches tail; exact-offset candidate subchunks remove permanent shortlist and regex-only admission

title: Plan-v2 step 3: Evolving scope and ordered task reports
description:
Make automatic discovery maintain an evolving goal-scoped ledger, not repeatedly auto-Apply a newer plan and erase status.

Jev classifies exact supplied task spans and relates mentions to existing task IDs/earlier candidates/new work/uncertain. Give task meanings and acceptance context, never IDs alone. Local code owns stable IDs, versions, scope, evidence refs and transitions. Repeated paraphrases do not multiply denominator. Exact Beads IDs can later strengthen identity. Similar wording alone never transfers done; semantic same-task matches require same work/boundaries. If requests partition comparison candidates, no match in one shortlist is not proof of a new task. Materially expanded work gets a revised task scope with old completion inapplicable; ambiguous identity is unresolved, not silently merged/newly counted.

Infer current task from actual user direction/assistant present-work statements, never first unchecked. Active denominator concerns current conversational goal, not whole session/backlog. Add new actual work, preserve legitimate repeated evidence, archive old scope on clear new user goal without marking it done. Cancelled is not done; remove from active denominator only when conversation removes work from scope. Quotes/alternatives/hypotheticals do not become commitments. Unreliable denominator means Unknown, not guessed percentage or a manual picker.

Interpret explicit done/reopen/cancel/in-progress reports in entry/span order. Support task introduction plus completion within the same logical observation. Chunk task questions under20/24KiB, apply only complete validated transaction against its starting ledger revision. Reopen must survive batching. Cursor advances on committed outcomes, not dispatch; service failure never skips evidence. Valid ambiguity can be retained for future context without blocking the whole queue. Admission binds session/branch/scope/task revision/cursor. Status proofs survive bounded inspector-free history eviction. Health can never write completion.

Main tests first: paraphrase duplicate, genuine additional work, revised completed task, current-task ambiguity, competing/new goal, cancel vs removal, done then reopen across chunks, 23+ task atomic report, introduction+done same chunk, quote/intentions, ambiguous correction, stale response after branch/scope changes, replay exactly once, proof restore after eviction. Separate candidate recall failures from Jev identity errors in later live gate.

Done when ordinary evolving conversation gives stable automatic tasks/current task and correct reported fractions with explicit uncertainty, no source control, preserved order/provenance, and passing gates.
acceptance_criteria: Stable automatic identities/current task; paraphrases vs new/revised work resolved safely; ordered atomic done/reopen/cancel including same-chunk task creation; no guessed denominator or health completion writes; replay/branch/restore tests pass.
close_reason: Semantic scope relations preserve identities, invalidate revised completion, infer current task safely, and archive clear new goals; ordered reports remain atomic

title: Plan-v2 step 4: Automatic health and resilient runtime
description:
Complete replacement V1–V3 automatic task signals, autonomous failure handling and lifecycle resilience on the same working conversation loop. No consent/manual task/source UI returns.

Feed grounded automatic goal/current-task/owned criteria into existing Jev clarity Score0–3 and acceptance Choice rubrics. Missing current task or essential evidence is Unknown, not score0. Refresh semantic assessments only when relevant state changes; successful identical input and rendering do not create requests. Local pure display mapping: [0,1)=unclear,[1,2)=partly clear,[2,3)=mostly clear,exact3=clear; missing/nonfinite/out-of-range=unknown. 2.7 renders 'Requirements: mostly clear', not2.7/3; do not round first. Choice labels, timestamps and status text also local. No additional model call to write labels, rationale or summaries. Confidence is distinct from rubric score. Health never updates report ledger.

Runtime scheduling: default60s analysis-cycle starts, interval command5–86400s; startup/on may catch up immediately; up to3 serial requests/cycle,10s deadline,24KiB/20questions,128KiB responses, one flight. Pending work carries across cycles. Remove inherited15s dispatch override and60-attempt enablement budget. Fair turns for extraction/reports/health, not continual cancellation/starvation. User-only changes and last idle-turn reports process on timer. No evidence=no new calls.

Missing/rejected key is error+OFF. Transient network/5xx/429/timeout failures retain cursor and visibly stale/as-of progress; exponential backoff at least configured interval, honor longer Retry-After. At most3 attempts/burst, attempts count toward cycle limits; then5min cooldown and one probe before a new bounded burst. New evidence does not evade global backoff. Malformed/oversized results reject atomically, bounded retry/cooldown; permanent request/model configuration errors report+OFF. No resume/enable. Off aborts before late-result cleanup and stops collection; on resumes current-branch catch-up. Reload/tree/session changes invalidate outstanding generations and revalidate checkpoint refs/status proofs. Restore controls without accidentally re-enabling OFF on tree navigation. Old manual checkpoints ignored, no migration.

Main tests first: all score boundary/invalid cases and zero network on rendering; separate ledger authority; real gateway wiring with test-only injected transport; budget beyond60 successful requests; low interval honored, max3/cycle; Retry-After/cooldown, recovery, no duplicate commit; off/reload/tree at every pending stage; single timer/flight/fairness; Unicode narrow rendering and concise freshness/error states. Keep credentials/raw responses out of checkpoints/errors.

Done when default-on progress plus readable current-task health survives long/offline/reload/branch sessions without manual recovery workflow, obsolete consent/checklist/inspector paths removed, README accurately states automatic paid Jev use, and all gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: Readable clarity/acceptance with pure local labels; zero rendering calls; autonomous bounded retries/fairness and long-running monitoring without lifetime cutoff; off/tree/reload and key errors safe; old manual paths removed; gates pass.
close_reason: Local health labels, timer-started three-request cycles, no lifetime wall, bounded retry/backoff/cooldown and credential shutdown verified

title: V4: Automatic grounded Beads enrichment
description:
V4 under plan v2: automatically enrich active conversation tasks with grounded Beads issue identities/context. This supersedes the old design's manually selected export/source/issue-ID dialogs. No new command or setup step.

Recognize actual present-task Beads use from conversation and, if supported safely, finalized command metadata paired with its result. Mentioning 'beads', quoted instructions, or a tool name alone is not enough. Keep issue ID attached to stable automatic task identity so paraphrases/references do not create duplicates. Treat epic/container and actionable children separately; do not count parent plus children twice or infer all dependencies are current scope.

Optionally read the conventional workspace .beads/issues.jsonl as bounded read-only enrichment for relevant grounded IDs (titles/relationships; status corroboration). Verify a concrete supported beads_rust export schema against local fixtures; no speculative universal bd compatibility. Validate workspace/realpath boundary, symlinks, byte/record limits, duplicate IDs, malformed/status-unknown records and stable atomic read. Missing selected record or interrupted file is incomplete, not deletion. File mtime/export revision is not live database freshness.

Conversation reports remain count authority in this batch. Export status may corroborate or expose disagreement/freshness; stale export must never silently complete/reopen a task or replace the active goal. No whole-backlog denominator or source ownership switch. Absent/stale/unsupported export simply leaves ordinary conversation monitoring working. Mandatory real Jev/key still applies; structured data is not a local-only mode.

Strict passivity: no br/bd/bv execution, installation, initialization, sync/import/flush, issue write or database access by the extension. The implementation agent may use br to track this repository's work; this prohibition concerns extension runtime.

Main tests first: actual usage vs incidental/quoted mention, stable issue-ID reuse, epic+child no double count, no backlog inclusion, stale export contradiction, malformed/duplicate/partial export, safe paths, absent CLI/export, no database/exec/write, health/report authority unchanged. Visible output needs compact provenance/conflict state, not an inspector or generated explanation.

Done when normal issue-oriented conversation yields better grounded automatic tasks with no user configuration, can operate with no Beads executables on PATH, preserves count authority and passes gates.
acceptance_criteria: Actual Beads usage strengthens identity/context automatically; no whole-backlog or parent-child double count, stale export status overwrite, source picker, CLI/DB mutation or installation. Missing tools/export harmless; supported-schema/path/partial-read tests pass.

title: V5: Passive red-test applicability and provenance
description:
V5: add automatic current-task red-test applicability and evidence row. No manual task selection, details/inspector, extra command, tool execution or advice. Use only shared real Jev gateway and deterministic labels.

Keep independent fields: (1) whether adding a NEW failing regression test is useful/required for this task; (2) red-test evidence/provenance. Not needed is first class, particularly for documentation/planning or work where another new test adds no value. It is not permission to skip existing checks or explicit user/project test requirements. Small changes alone do not justify Not needed (e.g. one-line permission bug). Use known applicable policy when actually available; otherwise preserve uncertainty rather than invent policy access.

Explicit actual task-linked agent assertion of a failing regression test is sufficient for Reported red; observed execution is NOT required for that label. Hypotheticals/quotes do not qualify. Observed red requires a narrowly supported actual assertion-failure result with trustworthy call/run identity, task/source linkage and ordering. isError/nonzero exit, missing dependency, runner crash, filename or test-file write alone cannot establish it. Contradictory claims remain visible. Test-first requires matching failure-before-implementation history; absence of history is not proof. A later pass does not erase a correctly linked historical red observation, but new task/source revisions can make its relevance stale.

Add minimal reusable passive evidence collection for V5/V6 from the active branch only: bind toolCallId to actual finalized invocation/result, allowlist supported host operations and concrete runner output shapes, retain provenance/offsets/order and source revision where available. Verify adapter contracts against installed Pi types and real sanitized fixtures; tool name or registration alone is not historical authenticity. Treat payloads as untrusted data; extract bounded factual evidence, never obey embedded instructions or promote generic tool text to user/assistant reports. Exclude private/excludeFromContext output, thinking, secrets and sibling/child logs. Do not run tests/read arbitrary files to obtain missing evidence; unsupported formats remain Unknown. No universal runner parser/framework.

Main tests first: documentation applicability, high-stakes tiny change, explicit policy override, explicit reported red without output, supported assertion failure, runner crash/nonzero, spoofed/mismatched call IDs, quotes, later green, absent/out-of-order/stale history, independent applicability/evidence, no completion writes or agent intervention. TypeSafe applicability/relevance judgments must not become instructions to the coding agent.

Done when automatic task widget distinguishes Not needed, Reported red, Observed red and unknown/contradiction/freshness with real provenance and local wording; passive evidence seam is usable by V6; no claim of live accuracy until final bounded evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Independent Not needed applicability and Reported/Observed red evidence; explicit assertion sufficient for Reported; observed assertion failure requires bound supported run evidence, not crash/nonzero. Local labels, no interventions/completion writes; provenance and policy tests pass.

title: V6: Criterion-linked implementation assessment
description:
V6: automatically assess implementation evidence for the current task's owned acceptance criteria, independently of reported completion. Keep passive/no-command operation, only shared real Jev for semantic judgments, and deterministic display labels.

Use exact criterion spans extracted from current goal/task conversation and narrowly supported passive code/edit/test observations collected in V5. Keep source/task revision, entry/call/run identity, chronology and coverage per criterion. Agent self-report remains report evidence, not independent proof implementation satisfies criteria. No workspace-wide crawling, hidden builds/tests, shell execution, code generation or general-purpose LLM. Unsupported/missing source linkage is Unknown, not fabricated observation.

Ask independent per-criterion typed Choices (supports/contradicts/insufficient evidence) over relevant bounded evidence; batch under existing request/cycle limits. Do not infer complete criteria from a truncated prefix. Local aggregation: any current contradiction -> contradicted; incomplete/missing/stale essential coverage -> unverified or partial according to supported criteria; only full known criteria coverage with supporting current evidence can display 'appears complete'. These labels remain assessments, never proof of arbitrary correctness. No multiplied confidence or numeric percent masquerading as probability the whole task is correct.

After relevant task/code changes, linked prior passing evidence becomes stale unless observed revision still matches. Preserve report history: task can remain reported done while implementation is partial/contradicted/unverified. Health reducer has no completion writer. Unknown current task means unknown implementation row, not first-unchecked inference. Keep compact human-readable widget output; no resurrected details menu or model-generated rationale. Internal evidence refs and raw typed results support tests/evaluation; privacy-safe checkpoints only.

Main tests first: two criteria with supported+missing => not appears complete; supported+contradicted; fully covered supported case; report says done but code evidence partial; self-report-only insufficient; omitted criteria/evidence; task/code revision invalidation; stale passing test linkage; malformed answers; branch late response; immutable completion ledger; no extra model calls for aggregate wording or rendering.

Done when normal conversation yields visible implementation assessment beside reported progress, per-criterion evidence/coverage drives local aggregation, relevant revisions age evidence correctly, and deterministic gates pass. Final real evaluation must separately count false 'appears complete' cases.
acceptance_criteria: Supported/contradicted/insufficient per-criterion evidence produces local implementation labels with complete coverage and revision freshness. Reported done remains independent. No proof claims from self-report/missing evidence, no hidden execution or label model; gates pass.

title: Deliver plan-v2 through V6: Live validation and user handoff
description:
Deliver the complete plan-v2 replacement plus V4–V6 as one installable human-test checkpoint, not just an issue backlog or injected-response demo. Blocked until all preceding implementation tickets are verified.

Run make format, make check (Biome/TypeScript/Knip), make test (unit then integration), package dry-run and isolated actual Pi load/shutdown. Existing stack: Bun1.3.14, Node>=22.19.0, tested Pi @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent0.84.2; verify installed contracts, no legacy compatibility layer. Missing standardized targets are unavailable with repo-native fallback, not automatic code failure. Real failures block delivery. Install dependencies only if the environment permits; never bypass package/host safety restrictions.

Run bounded REAL Jev validation against https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, pinned jev-1.13.0 (verify availability, no silent model alias/provider fallback). Require TYPESAFE_API_KEY in implementing process; never disclose it. Before dispatch record sanitized input fixtures, expected outcomes and an explicit finite call/input-size budget in ignored artifacts; no unbounded retries or automatic evaluation sweep. Ordinary tests stay offline. Runtime has no simulated mode. If credentials/model access are absent or the allowed evaluation budget is inadequate, record exact blocker and request user action rather than claim live success.

Live cases: plain/compound task requests, parent-vs-child span selection, paraphrase dedupe, changed requirements, new goal, quotes/intentions, task introduced+done, later reopen/cancel, Beads-ID grounding, Not needed vs explicit Reported red vs supported Observed red, runner crash, and implementation supported/contradicted/missing coverage. Record actual model, questions, selected spans, answers, latency, returned usage and failures. Separate parser candidate-recall failures, Jev errors and controller failures. Reserve held-out examples; do not claim broad accuracy from a few tuned examples or hide errors by reintroducing source confirmation.

Demonstrate with actual Pi in temporary configuration: valid key -> no commands -> tasks/report fraction/current-task and readable health; off/on/interval; low/high activity; no calls on unchanged history; long-history catch-up; missing/rejected key; offline/backoff; reload/tree; narrow terminal; automatic Beads optional behavior; red-test and implementation rows. Tests are engineering work; extension itself never runs them or nudges the agent.

One fresh bounded read-only review of full replacement +V4–V6 diff, including inherited reused code, authority/privacy, lifetime windows, races, API costs and test realism. Parent/main owns failing regressions for valid findings; scope fixes to concrete issues, rerun gates. Prior reviewer timed out and is NOT approval. Do not repeatedly run reviewers for tiny changes or let a timed-out review silently pass.

Rewrite README and stale product/design status to match actual behavior: default ON, required key/automatic paid content transfer, only on/off/interval, automatic scope, local labels, Jev only, default interval/cycle limits, error states, optional Beads, supported evidence formats, pending semantic limitations. Remove obsolete consent/source/manual checklist/inspector claims; no compatibility aliases. V7 meaningful-progress/stuck/drift remains explicitly unimplemented. Pack only intended runtime/docs; no raw sessions/keys/private fixtures/ignored plans.

Close verified child issues, flush Beads, make final conventional jj commit and leave clean fresh change. Do not create/switch branches. Give user exact load/install command, commit ID, what was actually tested, live costs/results, residual risks and a short no-commands smoke scenario. This handoff is the user's opportunity to test the WHOLE requested batch and provide feedback.
